LanguageData.HD_Shotgun_SpreadAngle_Desc:
Base angular spread: {0}

One shell has one shared aiming error. Its pellets scatter independently around that aim, spreading further with distance. A smaller angle makes a tighter pattern. Ammunition can modify this spread. Target size and posture affect how many pellets hit.

Each pellet checks armor separately and loses damage and penetration over distance. Internal parts can be damaged only after a pellet penetrates the corresponding body surface. Surface and internal injuries share that pellet's damage budget.

Injuries of the same type on the same body part are grouped only within the same shell. Earlier wounds, tended injuries and permanent scars remain separate. The injury label shows how many pellets contributed.
LanguageData.HD_Shotgun_PatternDiameter_Desc: Approximate diameter, in map tiles, containing 90% of pellets at a distance of 10 tiles for the weapon's base spread. This describes the pattern around its aim; it does not include the shooter's aiming error or ammunition spread modifiers. The diameter grows in proportion to distance.
